question: Inside a family that has already produced real edges (identical-claim RV: ETF-sibling, dual-class, T12 CEF discount), does the HOLDCO / CORPORATE-STRUCTURE branch contain one too?

sub_groups.P: paired-entity / dual-listed-company / holdco-of-one-asset -- two listed lines that are the SAME claim with a stated (usually 1:1) exchange right. BIPC/BIP, BEPC/BEP, BAMR/BAM, BBL/BHP, RDS.A/RDS.B, UN/UL, PAGP/PAA.
sub_groups.H: holdco or tracking stock whose dominant asset is a LISTED stake. Ratio drifts, so estimated not asserted. Liberty complex, DVMT/VMW, DELL/VMW, IAC/MTCH, IAC/ANGI, L/CNA, IEP/CVI, FMX/KOF, HRG/SPB, BN/BAM, NVST/DHR.
sub_groups.S: post-spinoff parent/child PAIR-RV (the drift is already known dead). 40 pairs.
sub_groups.M: stock-for-stock merger deal-ratio spread -- target contractually convertible into a FIXED number of acquirer shares. 34 deals.

method.fill: NEXT session's close after the signal close -- no same-bar fill
spread_measures: z of cumulative return spread (no level anchor)
z of rolling-OLS log-price residual (estimated hedge ratio)
level vs the CONTRACTUAL ratio (group P/M only)
method.corporate_action_guard: |dlog(ratio)| > 0.15 in one session = corporate action: re-anchor the contractual ratio, abandon any open position (not booked as P&L)
method.costs: 2 crossings per leg x Corwin-Schultz half-spread measured per symbol per window + SEC s31 0.278bp on each sale + borrow on the short leg pro-rata (T6/T7/M0 conventions)

group_H_design.note: 10 of 170 trades (6%) require shorting IEP or LTRPA and carry 68% of the design P&L. Neither is shortable at the broker.

shortability_screen.group_S: unaffected -- no unshortable leg in the spinoff universe

robustness.concentration: every group's design P&L is carried by 3-4 pairs: P 42% PAGP/PAA + 35% from THREE BEPC/BEP trades; H 41% IEP/CVI + 30% LTRPA/TRIP; S 26% HLT/PK + 20% from THREE HON/REZI trades; M the four largest cash-and-stock deals are 56%.

data_constraint.what_free_data_DOES_give: Alpaca SIP free tier serves daily bars for DELISTED tickers back to 2016-01-04, which is what made groups P/H/M testable at all: DVMT, VMW, XLNX, BBL, RDS.A/B, UN, BAMR, CXO, RTN, UTX, CELG, ETFC, MXIM, PXD, HES, PACW, CIT, UMPQ all resolve.
what_it_does_NOT_give: Point-in-time HOLDCO CONSTITUENT RATIOS. Liberty Broadband's CHTR-per-share, Liberty SiriusXM's SIRI-per-share, Loews' CNA stake, IEP's CVI stake all drift with buybacks and issuance and there is no free point-in-time series. Group H therefore uses an ESTIMATED ratio (rolling z / rolling OLS), which downgrades it from an identical-claim trade to an ordinary statistical pair. This is the single biggest binding constraint in this sub-family.
Point-in-time NAV / sum-of-parts for holdcos with UNLISTED parts (FWONA, BATRA, GLIBA, QRTEA) -- excluded entirely.

A survivorship-free MERGER DEAL LIST. Group M's 34 deals come from recall, and recall is overwhelmingly of deals that CLOSED. There is no free machine-readable universe of announced US stock-for-stock deals with exchange ratios. The design-window group-M number is therefore an UPPER BOUND, not an estimate.
Historical BORROW RATES. B22G could only obtain a same-day IBKR snapshot; the 0.33%/10.28% pair is applied as a constant across ten years.
ADR<->ordinary mappings and non-US ordinaries (Prosus/Tencent, SoftBank/Alibaba, Exor/Ferrari) -- not on the free US tape at all; that whole international holdco branch is untested.

data_hygiene_traps_found.ticker_recycling_and_stitching: Alpaca serves a series BY TICKER and silently stitches successive occupants. Verified by price level: BBT is Beacon Financial (not BB&T), STI is Solidion Technology (not SunTrust) -- the STI/BBT all-stock deal had to be DROPPED. DOW carries Dow Chemical's last price FLAT from 2017-08 to 2019-04-01 then becomes Dow Inc -- the DD/DOW 1.282 deal had to be DROPPED. LLL is L3 stitched to L3Harris; AMTD is TD Ameritrade stitched to AMTD IDEA; UN is Unilever NV then a leveraged UNH ETF.
guards_applied: per-symbol validity windows established by price-level verification
gap segmentation (>20 calendar-day hole = different listing)
stale-price drop (>=5 identical consecutive raw closes)

why: N=130 formula configurations were evaluated on the design window. The expected maximum |t| under the null for 130 tries is sqrt(2 ln 130) = 3.12 SE. The BEST design t across all 130 was 2.35. Nothing cleared the bar -- not one configuration, in any of the four groups.
The design t distribution is centred on zero (median 0.12, p25 -0.60, p75 0.99, 68/130 positive). That is what a null looks like.

The design-selected formula in every group collapses out of sample: P +80bp -> +13bp (t 0.26); S +168bp -> -8bp; M +190bp -> -559bp. Only H rose (+110 -> +152bp) and H had the LOWEST design t of the four (1.43) and dies on the shortability screen (design t 1.43 -> 0.50).

The one holdout configuration above 3.12 (H ret/L60/K2.5, t=3.21) is holdout mining, not confirmation: on the design window that same group produced the four WORST t-stats in the entire sweep (-2.75, -2.24, -1.82, ...).
At the measured HTB borrow rate (10.28%/yr, B22G) three of four groups are negative on both windows.
Every group's design P&L is carried by 3-4 pairs, several by literally three trades.
what_would_change_the_answer: A point-in-time holdco constituent-ratio series (would turn group H from a statistical pair back into a true identical-claim trade). Not free.
A survivorship-free announced-deal universe with exchange ratios (would let group M be measured rather than bounded). Not free.
A borrow-rate history (would let the P/H shorts be costed instead of assumed). Not free.
None of these is a parameter-tuning problem, so no further sweep of this family on free data is worth running.
